arms.current_only: RetainedScene::enable_temporal_upscaling(current_only_config): jittered current frame resampled, no history
arms.native: RetainedScene::enable_metalfx(PreferMetalFx, review_config); every native step must select MetalFx (Expect::Native), so a portable fallback fails selections_as_planned

budgets.counting: Every world-frame submission (off references and frames whose PNG is not kept included) is one actual submission; the late cases submit no UI. Readback copies are part of their frame's observation. Each case's planned submissions and PNGs are debited, fsynced, under the global GPU lock before launch and never refunded, so failed or interrupted cases stay charged. A failed case latches stop.json; nothing is retried.

builds.features: appended from the grant: --features <one allowlisted set>

expected_reference_rgba_sha256.source: transitions off-b and off-b-d8 in visual-evidence-002/reports/transitions.json (150e76cb); an observation for the reviewer, not a contract

late_stationary.purpose: Static view B (transitions' second viewpoint, no cut). One preferring native owner for 16 frames each at 16/16, 12/16 and 8/16; each scale change resets native history exactly as transitions d12-7 and d8-10 did, so frame 1 of each reduced segment is the reset frame and frames 8 and 16 show one and two jitter cycles of accumulation. Same-source 8/16 controls: portable (16 frames) and current-only (8 frames, for the current-coverage boundary band), plus unjittered references at 16/16, 12/16 and 8/16. The 002 striation is measured on the same flat face (STRIATION_RECT) for every milestone frame and control.

late_motion.purpose: View A with modest combined motion: the mover advances a quarter of the motion case's step per frame (0.0875 world units, about 5 px) toward the thin wall while the camera pans at a quarter of camera_world's speed. Fresh native owners at 12/16 and 8/16 and a portable 8/16 control each run the same 16 path steps, so frame 1 is each owner's reset frame; unjittered references at path steps 1, 8 and 16 serve every arm.

order: root grants review-ready.json for stage metalfx-late in 0074-metalfx-late-001 (source 077f7c39, freeze 62db43cb, features, this visual tree, target, holder, prior pins)

build.py lint (strict Clippy, CPU only; a failure exits nonzero and latches stop)

gpu.py review late_stationary|late_motion (this order, one foreground child each)
analyze.py check (requires complete passing evidence and both clean releases; always retains a summary)
personal inspection of every retained PNG
